## Example slide with **bolding** and *italics*

-   Bold text in markdown using **2 asterisks** on either side of the text
-   Italicize text in markdown using *1 asterisk* on either side of the text
-   *Escape* a character (i.e. a tilde (\~)) in your text by including a back-slash (\\) before the tilde
